properties.name: Requirements and accepted decisions linked to no other intent are noticed, and capture offers a new requirement's relations
properties.rationale: The 2026-10-07 root cause found that the three records outside a sixteen-record vision were all requirements, which unreviewed_ideas never looks at. A sibling finding rather than widening unreviewed_ideas keeps that finding's meaning (an idea nobody has reviewed) and gives the new one its own denominator. Anthony kept F1 to F5 on 2026-10-07.

properties.summary: Item 6 of the one-graph build order (F1 and F5 of req:the-pieces-of-one-picture-are-found-together). A new gap finding, unlinked_intent, covers requirements and accepted decisions as unreviewed_ideas covers open ideas. capture-intent offers relation_candidates on a new requirement. The link-ideas skill works the backlog.
